import os, json, signal, time
def read_proc(name):
    fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY, dir_fd=3)
    try:
        chunks = []
        while True:
            data = os.read(fd, 65536)
            if not data: break
            chunks.append(data)
        return b''.join(chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
def link(name):
    return os.readlink(name, dir_fd=3)
root_ns = link('1/ns/pid')
self_ns = link(str(os.getpid()) + '/ns/pid')
assert os.geteuid() == 0 and self_ns == root_ns
entries = []
for name in os.listdir(3):
    if not name.isdigit(): continue
    try:
        if read_proc(name + '/comm').decode().strip() != 'chronyd': continue
        raw_stat = read_proc(name + '/stat').decode().strip()
        stat_parts = raw_stat.rsplit(') ', 1)[1].split()
        cmdline = [x.decode() for x in read_proc(name + '/cmdline').split(b'\0') if x]
        exe = link(name + '/exe')
        metadata = os.stat(name + '/exe', dir_fd=3)
        config_path = '/etc/chrony.conf'
        for i, value in enumerate(cmdline[1:], 1):
            if value == '-f': config_path = cmdline[i + 1]
            elif value.startswith('-f') and len(value) > 2: config_path = value[2:]
        config = read_proc(name + '/root' + config_path).decode()
        pidfd = os.pidfd_open(int(name))
        os.close(pidfd)
        entries.append({'pid': int(name), 'exe': exe, 'cmdline': cmdline,
            'state': stat_parts[0], 'ppid': int(stat_parts[1]), 'start_ticks': stat_parts[19],
            'pid_namespace': link(name + '/ns/pid'), 'mount_namespace': link(name + '/ns/mnt'),
            'exe_metadata': {'device': metadata.st_dev, 'inode': metadata.st_ino, 'size': metadata.st_size, 'mtime_ns': str(metadata.st_mtime_ns)},
            'raw_stat': raw_stat, 'status': read_proc(name + '/status').decode(),
            'configuration_path': config_path, 'configuration': config, 'pidfd_open_verified': True})
    except FileNotFoundError:
        continue
assert len(entries) == 1
entry = entries[0]
assert entry['exe'] == '/usr/sbin/chronyd' and entry['ppid'] == 1 and entry['pid_namespace'] == root_ns
assert entry['state'] not in ('T', 't', 'Z', 'X')
result = {'root_pid_namespace': root_ns, 'python_pid_namespace': self_ns,
    'root_proc_fd_verified': True, 'python_pid': os.getpid(), 'uid': os.geteuid(),
    'pidfd_send_signal_available': hasattr(signal, 'pidfd_send_signal'),
    'boot_id': read_proc('sys/kernel/random/boot_id').decode().strip(),
    'python_version': os.sys.version, 'chronyd': entry,
    'clocksource': open('/sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource').read().strip(),
    'phc_clock_name': open('/sys/class/ptp/ptp0/clock_name').read().strip(),
    'raw_ns': str(time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW))}
print('A2_IDENTITY_JSON=' + json.dumps(result), flush=True)
